name: overview-native-tracker
goal: Read Project Overview from the native Tracker after cutover while preserving fixed loopback reads and fail-closed validation.

evidence: Native hub after cutover returns 200 for /items and /runs, 404 for /machines and 200 for /status with a machines array. Existing Explorer and publisher fail closed before projection.

The tracked readProjectOverview standard transport case exercised only a tracker with /machines. Extend it to also require native /status.machines on a dedicated 404 while preserving strict URL, HTTP and response assertions.
Committed ff4b15e536. Fixed-GET case rejected the native 404 fixture with unavailable where ready was expected; 1 failed, 12 passed.
Fallback is restricted to a 404 on fixed /machines. Native /status shares the same deadline, and only the validated machines field reaches the overview.
Frozen red failed on ff4b15e536; the same committed test and runtime passed all 13 cases on ebded0133e. Reports focused suites passed all 57.
